'''Mr. Monday Night Damsel In Distress''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Published:''' 1 January 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed RTP Night LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Plop Lando, Chewie, Han, Luke, Obi, Qui onto the death star, and let them rescue the princess. Leave Corran, Talon, Dash, and 8D8 on Yavin 4 (so your opponent won't try to overrun the place and wait for you). Bring Leia back to yavin, and leave here there with Talon, Dash, 8D8, and Corran, and then send the others off to battle everyone else. And since your opponent's character lose all immunity to attrition, you'll pretty much win every battle. Make 8D8 run the Death Star Plans, after the princess is rescued. Use Jedi Resilience to keep Qui, Obi, and Luke in the game longer. Use the bacta tank for chewie, lando, and han....that's pretty much it!!!
